Every other edge, inset, height and gap in the capture matches the spec's rects (headers at 147/178/234/406/678, rows at 259/331/459/531/603/703/775, controls at y 8/42/117), and the extra tab fits inside the 420 px tab bar without overflow. | [states] The tab strip shows a third tab, 'CONSOLIDATE' with a count badge of 2, after the Updates tab. The approved artboard draws only INSTALLED and UPDATES there, and the redline lists only installed-tab and updates-tab. design-system.md (overflow table row 'Tab strip (Installed/Updates, and Consolidate under All Projects)' and the Main · Consolidate states row) declares this tab under All Projects, so the artboard and redline look stale rather than the product being wrong. It is still an element the artboard lacks.
